name: email-course-signup
title: Email course signup
description: A five-day email course: the lesson outline day by day beside a signup field, so the promise is concrete before the email is given.
docs: Pass lessons (a day, a title and a one-line takeaway), onSubmit, a title, a description and the duration ('5 minutes a day'). The outline is a real ordered list with each lesson's day as its number. The card holds one email field, the start rule under the button ('Starts the day after you sign up'), an Unsubscribe any time note beside the button and the privacy line, which links to your policy when you pass privacyHref. The confirmation says where the lessons will arrive and when Day 1 comes: onSubmit may resolve with { firstLessonAt } (a time with its offset, or a plain day), which is written in locale and timeZone, and without it the confirmation repeats the start rule. It takes focus so a screen reader reads it. defaultValue, defaultStatus and defaultStart start the card filled or confirmed. labels translates every fixed word, the start rule and the unsubscribe note included.
